slices.user_visible_outcome: Known current regressions are reproduced and corrected without expanding permissions.
slices.scope: Inspect current HEAD, deployment assumptions and the failing confirmation-followup test; classify evaluator, active-dispatch, or combined cause before correction. Make the existing private-owner callback validate additive `prm_post_answer_action_binding.v1`: required source_result_id equals the lowercase 10-hex row/callback context_id and the canonical SHA-256 bounded source snapshot. canonical_private_owner_id accepts only canonical positive ASCII decimals [1-9][0-9]{0,18} at most 9223372036854775807; every Telegram text/voice, compatibility-dispatch and callback ingress propagates the authenticated tuple unchanged or renders no controls, and no path synthesizes actor_id. Legacy PRM markup has no tuple and is a tested no-controls path. One pure snapshot canonicalizer handles registration and validation; non-finite/non-serializable source renders no controls or receipt. Rejection is read-only until outer parse, tuple, row/status/expiry, schema/digest and offered action validate. Dynamic cancel, selection, reason and confirmation codes require the exact issued persisted transition after a valid initial offer. The evaluator separately denies legacy free-text action without preview/callback/retrieval/eval ID and validates a declared immutable bound-inline source fixture. test_interaction_ledger uses the regular explicit private tuple, not a fixture backdoor. Repair UTD clean-schema state mapping without migration: summary_json utd_state maps draft/previewed-or-confirming/confirmed/cancelled-or-expired to ready/pending/confirmed/cancelled, while untagged legacy pending fails closed. Implement read_prm_rollback_drain across established PRM/UTD hashes as SELECT-only and fail-closed. Record a fresh, hash-bound focused baseline including HEAD/runtime mode/evaluator synthetic context IDs; do not claim complete plain-language confirmation before PA-03.
expected_interfaces: Existing PersonalResearchAssistant and Telegram dispatch remain compatible
canonical_private_owner_id(value) accepts only one positive canonical Telegram-ID spelling and equal canonical chat_id/actor_id/owner_chat_id are required for controls

PRM message/voice, compatibility-dispatch and callback paths carry an authenticated chat_id/actor_id/owner_chat_id tuple unchanged or render no controls; no missing identity can be synthesized; the callback facade returns its one pure validation result to _handle_callback before acknowledgement

validate_prm_post_answer_callback returns immutable ValidatedPrmAction or Unavailable without a write; apply_validated_prm_action consumes it once with a status/expiry/summary-json/proposals-json fingerprint compare-and-swap transaction and never reparses callback data
Legacy PRM post-answer markup has no authenticated tuple and receives reply_markup=None
source_result_id, row context_id and callback context ID are the same lowercase 10-hex token

canonicalize_prm_action_snapshot(answer) has the exact documented keys, ordered deduplication and absent-value handling; direct_count/partial_count are non-boolean integers 0..1000000 and source_project_ref is absent or the exact bounded snapshot project_name copy; an unverifiable source renders no control, context or receipt
Dynamic c, n1-n5, feedback reason and confirmation codes require their exact persisted issued parent state; otherwise they are read-only unavailable
The evaluator has separate free-text denial and declared immutable bound-inline provenance cases; it does not manufacture callback state

encode_utd_proposal_state/decode_utd_proposal_state plus guarded transition_utd_proposal are the sole UTD codec; every transition compare-and-swaps expected logical state, mapped status and prior JSON fingerprint in one transaction, so concurrent confirm/cancel has exactly one winner; canonical-schema tests cover every transition and any bad pair fails closed
The UTD codec and its typed applied/unavailable transaction result live only in assistant.utd_profile_store; profile callers own no direct proposal-state SQL or nested transaction
Outer callback handling converts malformed parse/row JSON and every invalid binding to the same read-only unavailable result

Callback validation is read-only before all parse, identity, row/status/expiry, binding/digest and offered-action checks pass; read_prm_rollback_drain invokes the established PRM and UTD owner-hash helpers, uses a read-only SELECT-only connection across both namespaces, and returns only status/UTC-now/blocker-count/classification-counts
PA-03, not PA-00, owns ConversationState.current_confirmation_ref for plain-language yes
slices.review_checkpoint: Test Critic and focused code review; distinguish evaluator correction from product correction and prove the historical split evaluator cases before/after, the parameterized Telegram-ID ingress matrix, legacy no-controls behavior, ledger fixture tuple parity, exact identifier/snapshot canonicalization, dynamic issued-action positive/forged state transitions, immutable validation-to-CAS mutation handoff before _handle_callback acknowledgement, malformed callback/row JSON read-only rejection with zero receipt/memory/expiry/proposal writes, canonical-schema UTD mapping and every guarded codec transition including concurrent confirm/cancel, both hash namespaces with a genuine current-UTD-path blocker and owner-restricted SELECT-only no-mutation rollback drain, missing/tampered/expired/wrong-chat/wrong-actor/topic denial and zero application/search calls from an old callback
slices.rollback: No schema migration. Stop rendering controls and retain the PA-00 handler in fail-closed drain mode. UTD mapping is additive summary_json state; the shared drain blocks rollback to old UTD/PRM handlers until all mapped unexpired nonterminal rows are gone. It never DELETEs/UPDATEs, treats legacy, unknown and UTD rows as blockers, and preserves confirmed receipts, UTD drafts and the baseline failure receipt.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The approved design has concrete contracts, baseline scenarios and unambiguous completion criteria.
slices.scope: Review program/UX design, write versioned capability, evidence, report and action contracts; create a representative synthetic acceptance corpus and source coverage matrix before implementation.
slices.review_checkpoint: Independent product and program design reviews; exact hash-bound human approval before capability implementation
slices.rollback: Revert unapproved contract additions; preserve prior accepted versions and review records.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The operator can understand and control what each tool/model may read, send and change.
slices.scope: Capability registry, account/resource-scoped grants, consistent text/voice/model egress, revocation and budget enforcement; text-model egress must bind a non-null opaque connection ref to the exact credential loaded at transport time and creates no durable usage/cost telemetry. Private archive context remains denied in PA-02: caller-supplied source references and snippets are not repository provenance, so PA-04 must bind selected archive evidence before any private context may cross a provider boundary. Authenticated equal private Telegram ingress may propagate a bounded non-persistent return-envelope decision only for its same-chat response or callback acknowledgement. UTD local writes and every legacy callback namespace remain default-deny in PA runtime without a separately scoped exact authorization. A private `/privacy` route reports the current durable enforced scope but creates, stores and revokes no grant; no live enablement.
expected_interfaces: decode_capability_grant_document(document) fails closed at the PA-01/PA-02 boundary
provider policy and one-use budget reservation before every egress
external Anthropic/OpenAI model egress accepts only a non-null opaque connection ref derived from the exact credential loaded at transport time and grants no usage/cost database write
private archive context egress stays denied until PA-04 supplies repository-verified selected-evidence binding; a caller-shaped source_ref never enables provider input
private /privacy reports actual active or default-deny scope without creating a grant

private Telegram ingress may issue only an exact same-chat, bounded in-memory return-envelope delivery decision for a result, status or callback acknowledgement; UTD local writes and every legacy callback namespace remain denied without separately scoped authorization
slices.review_checkpoint: Immediate privacy/security and Test Critic review of allow/deny, PA-01 grant codec, revocation, private permission explanation and voice bypass cases
slices.rollback: Disable new capabilities by default; keep prior read-only archive available.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Natural dialogue, editing, topic changes and followups work without memorizing commands.
slices.scope: Conversation object references, explicit AI mode, model-backed dialogue, safe context assembly, restart retention policy, cancellation, truthful error states and an explicit current confirmation reference for plain-language yes. Product quality: Natural report corrections and follow-ups give substantive explanations over the correct object; command matching alone is not conversational acceptance.
slices.review_checkpoint: Conversation holdouts and mobile UX review; no keyword-only shortcut for context or confirmation; plain yes needs one current matching visible proposal
slices.rollback: Feature-flag new dialogue; retain local archive route and do not delete existing state.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Archive questions yield useful grounded answers, not just templated excerpts or blanket refusals.
slices.scope: Connect authorized model synthesis to the active application, including a default-deny Telegram ingress seam for an already-reserved paired text/archive access; improve retrieval and multilingual query handling on holdouts; preserve source identity and truthful no-result paths. Product quality: Topic and time instructions are separated; relevant omissions and noisy inclusions are measured alongside claim support.
slices.review_checkpoint: Retrieval/synthesis positives and negatives, wrong-citation mutations, false-refusal review, paired archive access ingress and source-bound provider-context review
slices.rollback: Disable the archive-synthesis access provider and retain the measured local renderer; derived indexes remain rebuildable.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The assistant actually searches the web and verifies current facts with primary sources.
slices.scope: Search-provider adapter, bounded public fetch, evidence extraction, freshness/conflict handling and private-query minimization. Implement complete on-demand path; live access needs its grant. Product quality: Current claims retain primary-source support and material uncertainty in readable partial answers.
slices.review_checkpoint: Immediate SSRF/DNS/redirect, prompt-injection and egress review; do not widen old UTD watch
slices.rollback: Disable new web capability without disabling local conversation/retrieval.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Complex questions combine web, archive and current project context into one useful answer.
slices.scope: Bounded multi-query research, independent parallel reads, gap-driven expansion, cancellation/checkpoints, GitHub read-only context and evidence-aware project recommendations. Product quality: Multi-source synthesis explains differences and conditional applicability to actual project context.
slices.review_checkpoint: Agent-loop termination, source coverage, project identity and cancellation holdouts
slices.rollback: Use standard single-query search; cancel pending expanded plans.

slices.user_visible_outcome: An on-demand weekly or topical briefing is concise, relevant, source-backed and conversational.
slices.scope: Versioned BriefDocument, period/timezone/coverage manifest, event dedupe, importance versus urgency, project sections, report history references and Telegram navigation. Product quality: Event-level editorial stories contain takeaways, explanations, selection rationale, optional next steps and source anchors; unknown priority fields never substitute for editorial work. Short/full/follow-up views use the same stored story identities.
slices.review_checkpoint: One independent review for the coherent content/conversation batch; scoped P0/P1 rechecks only. Separate source anchoring, semantic/content quality, provider evidence and human mobile acceptance.
slices.rollback: Hide new brief entrypoint; keep evidence snapshots and old archive research intact.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The same briefing becomes a beautiful private mobile HTML page, PDF or Markdown without changing its facts.
slices.scope: Accessible report design, private authenticated reader, PDF/Markdown export, version-preserving navigation and safe sharing previews; visual regression and factual cross-format checks. Product quality: Information hierarchy and meaningful tables/timelines/charts preserve the editorial story and its caveats; no new factual generation during export.
slices.review_checkpoint: Rendered Telegram/HTML/PDF visual review, Cyrillic/overflow/accessibility, source equality, private-link and XSS tests
slices.rollback: Disable web/export views; Telegram briefing remains functional.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Confirmed briefings, watches and reminders arrive reliably and stop when paused or revoked.
slices.scope: Durable job runner, scheduling/quiet hours/DST, outbox/reconciliation, change detection, caps, cancellation and feedback; reuse proven UTD boundaries without expanding its consent. Product quality: Each notification explains a meaningful change and its relevance; repeated reports of one event do not create noisy new alerts.
slices.review_checkpoint: Immediate schedule/permission/race review plus restart, duplicate, quiet-hour and revoked-grant holdouts
slices.rollback: Pause new scheduler; drain or cancel pending jobs without deleting receipts.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Selected mail can be searched and summarized with clear scope, freshness and account controls.
slices.scope: Provider discovery, OAuth read scopes, incremental/paginated sync, selected folder/filter with honest scope explanation, minimal derived storage, revocation/delete and private preview. No writes yet. Product quality: Thread summaries explain requested decisions, supported deadlines and optional opportunities rather than dumping mail excerpts.
slices.review_checkpoint: OAuth/security/privacy review; real account pilot only after scoped approval; fixtures do not prove provider integration
slices.rollback: Disconnect adapter, invalidate caches/jobs and delete derived data by approved retention policy.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The assistant can explain the schedule, check availability and resolve intended recipients.
slices.scope: Read-only calendar and contacts adapters, multiple-account identity, source/local timezones, recurring events, free/busy, pagination and consent/revocation. Product quality: Schedule answers explain conflicts, implications and available options with correct local/source times.
slices.review_checkpoint: Identity, ambiguity, recurrence/DST and restricted-field review; real provider evidence separate
slices.rollback: Disconnect read adapters without modifying upstream calendars/contacts.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Academic Inbox explains obligations and opportunities using permitted mail/Canvas/UTD evidence.
slices.scope: Research institutional permission, minimal Canvas read adapter, normalized candidates, stage-aware categories, authoritative and conflicting deadlines, completion states, relevance and reminder policy. Reuse the existing handoff, not a new bot. Product quality: Academic briefs distinguish obligations, opportunities and reading, with explained eligibility uncertainty and conflicting deadlines.
slices.review_checkpoint: Institutional permissions, false urgency/missed obligations, conflicting due dates, deletion and privacy review
slices.rollback: Disable academic sources/reminders independently; preserve Telegram archive and existing public watch permissions.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Specific mail/calendar actions execute only after exact confirmation and return verifiable receipts.
slices.scope: Version-bound proposals/confirmation, recipient resolution, free/busy and ETag checks, durable execution/idempotency, double-click resistance, cancellation and unknown-result reconciliation. Product quality: A finding can become a concrete editable proposal with source rationale, exact confirmation and an honest execution result.
slices.review_checkpoint: Mandatory independent security/Test Critic; adversarial confirmation/race tests; separate human approval for live writes
slices.rollback: Disable write grants, cancel unexecuted proposals and reconcile unknown outcomes before any retry.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The operator can inspect, correct, forget and reuse personal knowledge without hidden learning claims.
slices.scope: Memory provenance/retention, history and knowledge library, versioned preferences, scoped retrieval, corrections, privacy-safe export/delete and links to report history. Product quality: Explicit interests, projects and length/depth preferences improve future selection; feedback and saved preference changes remain inspectable and reversible.
slices.review_checkpoint: Provenance, false-learning, deletion propagation, context isolation and memory-injection review
slices.rollback: Stop new memory writes; retain inspect/delete compatibility for existing derived records.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Voice, images and documents participate in the same conversation and permission model.
slices.scope: Editable voice transcript, optional spoken output, safe image/document/PDF ingestion, bounded OCR only when necessary, page evidence and temporary-file lifecycle. Product quality: Voice, image and document follow-ups preserve report identity and readable explanations with source/page references.
slices.review_checkpoint: Malicious file, size/type, audio/text policy parity, cleanup and multimodal UX checks
slices.rollback: Disable new media types; plain text remains available and temporary data is purged.

slices.user_visible_outcome: Quality-first model choice and cost controls are measurable and understandable.
slices.scope: Provider/model registry, observed identity, exact pricing version, quality profiles, privacy-compatible fallback, caching and per-success telemetry; compare strong baseline versus routed candidate before savings claims. Product quality: Quality comparisons include editorial and multi-turn usefulness before model cost optimization.
slices.review_checkpoint: Paired quality/cost/latency holdouts; unknown-price and unapproved-fallback negatives; no unmeasured savings claims
slices.rollback: Return to approved fixed strong model, retaining spend caps and privacy restrictions.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The assistant recovers from failures, exposes health and has a tested safe upgrade/rollback path.
slices.scope: Deployment templates, migration rehearsals on copies, backup/restore, secrets rotation, monitoring, capacity/429 handling, worker crash recovery and operator runbooks; no automatic production deployment.
slices.review_checkpoint: Operations and privacy/security review; restore demonstration on synthetic copies; explicit deployment approval
slices.rollback: Document exact service/feature rollback, preserve receipts, restore only from verified backup with owner approval.

slices.user_visible_outcome: The complete assistant is accepted on real authorized workflows, not merely fixture passes.
slices.scope: Full requirement traceability, integrated holdouts, all export visual review, separately approved account/model/delivery pilot, usefulness/latency/cost measurements and exact-HEAD release decision. External blockers stay explicit. Product quality: Owner-calibrated held-out content and multi-turn scenarios gate acceptance separately from schema, provider and mobile evidence.
slices.review_checkpoint: Independent final integrated review and human visual/usefulness acceptance; no agent-issued release authority
slices.rollback: Stop pilot/automatic writes, retain read-only useful paths, record residual gaps and do not claim full completion.
